blocks.text: Business Insights API uses the following additional response codes and error messages that are specific to use cases and scenarios in Business Insights.

table: The request contains invalid syntax or parameters.
The JWT token is expired, invalid, or missing.
The wrong HTTP method was used for the endpoint.
The media type is unsupported. Wrong Content-Type header used.
Too many requests were sent, exceeding the rate limit.

An unexpected server-issue occurred, preventing the request from being processed. A transient error resolves itself by retrying the operation. For a non-transient error, contact Zscaler Support with the error details (including request ID, timestamp, and any other relevant details).

table: Invalid report type INVALID should be one of APPLICATION/WORKPLACE/DATA_EXPLORER
Invalid report subtype INVALID should be one of ScheduledReports/CustomDataFeed/SaveAndSchedule
Invalid time -999 should be in Epoch Second
Missing the required field in request body.
Missing the required field in request body.
The maximum of 50 active reports are already in use. If additional reports are required, contact Zscaler Support to make a request.

blocks.text: The following table lists the various error messages that might be sent for a 400 (BAD_REQUEST) response when using Custom Applications endpoints, including the possible cause for the error.

table: Custom Application name cannot be empty
Name field is null or empty.
Custom Application name cannot exceed length of 128 characters
Custom Application signatures cannot be empty
More than 50 HOST signatures are being used.
Global HOST count cannot be more than 500

blocks.text: The following table lists the various error messages that might be sent for a 400 (BAD_REQUEST) response when using Report Configurations endpoints, including the possible cause for the error.

table: Report name must not be null
CustomIds must contain at least one item
CustomIds contain more than one item
Multiple IDs were provided, but only one can be used.
SubType must be one of [OVERVIEW, USERS]
Either scheduleParams or backfillParams must be provided

blocks.text: To access Custom Applications and Report Configurations endpoints, users must have:

blocks.item: Report READ_WRITE permission for Create, Update, and Delete operations.
Report READ_ONLY permission for Get operations.
400 (BAD_REQUEST): Check the error details for specific validation errors. Also, ensure all required fields are present and values are in the correct format.
401 (unauthorized): Verify that your JWT token is valid and has not expired.
403 (FORBIDDEN): Ensure that you have the required RBAC permissions for the operation.
429 (RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED): Implement exponential backoff and reduce request frequency.
500 (INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR): Retry the operation. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support with the error details including the timestamp and request ID.
